fusions.name: Cowcatcher
fusions.desc: Rams the target with the cold plate on your prow. It deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sparks Off the Rails
fusions.desc: Grinds your wheels against cold rails. It deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 5 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Bolted Plating
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, raises your armour by 6%, and you move 10% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Chassis
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12% at all times.
